baseline.note: Introduce the explicit documentation review baseline for the existing application and release tooling without certifying historical behavior.

backup-recovery.migration: Previous books remain compatible at SQLite schema 17. Back up the closed database with adjacent originals and the profile before upgrade. Open a disposable copy first; the desktop profile migration retains compatibility access and refuses unsafe collisions. For rollback, preserve upgraded files and restore the complete pre-upgrade copy with the previous package; later edits are absent. DOCX expansion limits can refuse oversized inputs without changing stored books. Preset metadata uses the existing meta table without a schema migration. Missing and unknown stored values retain novel behavior; unknown values remain stored verbatim. Backups, archive restores, transfer, and salvage preserve this metadata. Older builds need no preset conversion.
backup-recovery.note: Document complete book and profile backups, interrupted migration preservation, archive boundaries, and restoring separate pre-upgrade copies. Backup, archive restore, portable transfer, and salvage retain preset metadata verbatim.

editor.note: Book creation offers three presets with aligned themed controls. Nonfiction reference labels preserve custom titles and fiction tools remain available under More; switching to a novel restores Cast.

encryption.note: Encrypted archive restore preserves optional preset metadata, including unknown stored values, while encryption, keys, passwords, and working-file protection boundaries remain unchanged.

maintenance.note: Preserve full-range migration, backup, and rollback assessments when adding optional preset metadata. Focused fixtures cover preset creation, export formatting, and metadata recovery.

native-packaging.no_impact: Desktop preset behavior adds no dependencies, packaging configuration, or capability permissions and leaves native distribution unchanged.
